描述_EN: cizhou ware is not easily defined, but this pillow is characteristic due to it stoneware body and incised and carved decoration. the deer are a symbol of reward for official service while the branch they hold in their mouths is perhaps from the plant of long life. as unusual as it might seem, ceramic pillows were not just used for burial, but also in life, as a neck support. the imagery on this pillow is set against a ring-punched background, creating a densely decorated surface imitating the more costly metalwork of the time. this pillow is an example of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the song dynasty (960-1279).
描述_ZN: 慈州器不容易定义，但这个枕头由于它的石器主体和刻画和雕刻的装饰而具有特征。 鹿象征着对官方服务的奖励，而它们嘴里叼着的树枝可能是来自长寿的植物。 虽然看起来很不寻常，但陶瓷枕头不仅仅是用于埋葬，在生活中也被用作颈部支撑。 这个枕头上的图像是以环形冲孔为背景，创造了一个密集的装饰表面，模仿了当时更昂贵的金属制品。 这个枕头是Cizhou ware的一个例子，Cizhou ware是宋朝（960-1279）时期中国北方地区的一种陶瓷类型。
